name: Example — how lore entries actually work
description: A working lorebook you can import, read, copy and edit. Every entry demonstrates one kind of thing you might want to write. Import it, open it in the editor, and change it into your own. It is ordinary SillyTavern world info, so it also works anywhere else.

0.comment: A PERSON — the most common kind of entry
0.content:
Reiko Amano, 17, Class 1-A. Quirk: Echo — she can replay any sound she has heard in the last hour, at any volume.
Looks: black hair cut blunt at the jaw, always a size too big in her uniform blazer, ink on her fingers.
Manner: answers questions late, as if she considered not answering. Says exactly what she means when she finally speaks. Does not raise her voice, ever.
With Bakugo: they trained together before UA and neither mentions it.

1.comment: A PLACE — fires when the place is named
1.content:
The UA rooftop. Chain link on three sides, open to the drop on the fourth. Wind constant enough that people lean into it without noticing. The access door sticks and announces anyone coming.
Students are technically not allowed up here after six. Nobody enforces it.

2.comment: A RELATIONSHIP — needs BOTH names present, not either
2.content:
Reiko and Bakugo trained together for two years before UA, at a gym neither of them names. It ended badly and neither has said why.
He is the only person she interrupts. She is the only person he lets interrupt him.
Neither has acknowledged any of this out loud.

3.comment: WORLD BACKGROUND — always on, because it is always true
3.content: Quirks: roughly 80% of the population has one, manifesting around age four. Using a quirk in public without a hero licence is a criminal offence. Licences are earned through the provisional exam at earliest.

4.comment: A SECRET — exists in the world, but only some people know it
4.content:
Bakugo has been going out on unlicensed night patrols for six weeks. He has a burn scar across his left palm from one of them that he has told no one about.
Who knows: Bakugo, Recovery Girl.
Who does not know: Reiko, Aizawa, his parents, everyone else.

5.comment: A SCENE that should linger — sticky keeps it loaded for 6 messages
5.content: The school festival runs all weekend. Class 1-A is running a food stall. Everyone is in costume, the courtyard is packed, and it is impossible to have a private conversation anywhere on the grounds.

6.comment: ONE OF A SET — only one entry from group 'weather' is ever used
6.content: It is raining hard enough to be loud on the windows. Everything outside is grey and close.

7.comment: ONE OF A SET — the other half of group 'weather'
7.content: Clear and cold. The kind of light that makes everything look further away than it is.

8.comment: RARE FLAVOUR — only fires one time in four, so it never gets stale
8.content: The cafeteria is run by Lunch Rush. The queue moves fast and the food is better than it has any right to be.

9.comment: SAY IT LATE — sits near the end of the prompt, where it carries more weight
9.content:
Shota Aizawa. Homeroom teacher, Class 1-A. Quirk: Erasure — cancels another person's quirk while he keeps eye contact, which dries his eyes and forces him to blink.
Speaks flatly and rarely repeats himself. Notices everything and comments on almost none of it.
